top_signals.title: Amid Iran conflict, ‘non-hostile’ deaths of 2 US airmen raise overseas toll
top_signals.summary: Two U.S. airmen supporting operations against Iran died last week in "non-hostile" incidents, raising the death toll to 23 since the war began.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: What Republicans' huge loss means for Trump
top_signals.summary: Trump's handling of tariffs, the Iran war and an array of Washington-area construction projects are sure to face sudden pushback from newly empowered Democrats.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: NIKKE PC game launcher hacked to spread remote access, data-stealing malware
top_signals.summary: The developers of Goddess of Victory: NIKKE have confirmed that hackers tampered with the game's PC launcher scripts in a supply-chain attack, distributing malware capable of stealing credentials and cryptocurrency wallet data. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Tweaks Debt-Sale Guidance, Signals Auction Changes Ahead
top_signals.summary: The US Treasury Department revamped the guidance on sales of notes and bonds it has used since early 2024, in a move that dealers said opens the door to ​larger sales of short-dated debt and potentially cuts to longer-dated auctions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.summary: Coinbase says 99% of customer assets are in cold storage and it wasn't affected by the $6.3 billion Binance hack.
